text.en: Several clients express severe disappointment with staff conduct at the salon. Reviewers describe argumentative interactions with groomers during appointments and report feeling dismissed when raising concerns about their pets, leading multiple dog owners to state they will not return.

Pet owners report significant frustration with communication from the salon team. Reviews highlight abrupt cancellations via phone calls or text messages just one day before scheduled visits, alongside unaddressed complaints and disputes over unrefunded booking deposits.

Multiple reviewers report persistent scheduling problems, noting that booked grooming sessions were repeatedly cancelled twenty-four hours in advance. Clients note that alternate dates were not promptly offered, causing significant disruption for owners trying to groom their dogs.

q.en: Can I expect reliable appointment scheduling?

a.en: Recent reviews indicate frequent last-minute cancellations by the salon, often notified only a day before the booked slot without convenient alternatives.

q.en: How do clients rate the grooming and nail clipping?

a.en: Feedback from the past year has been critical, with owners reporting uneven haircuts and stressful handling during nail trims for anxious pets.

q.en: Are booking deposits refunded if a session is cancelled?

a.en: Clients have reported difficulties obtaining deposit refunds following cancellations initiated by the branch, advising owners to clarify cancellation terms beforehand.
